# My Tempus

> My Tempus is a privacy-first, local-first life progress tracker for iPhone (iOS 17+). It visualizes your lifespan as an interactive grid, records moments with photos, moods, tags, and location, composes immersive Retrospect recaps with Story-mode playback, counts down to events, tracks companions including pets, and generates data wallpapers and Home Screen widgets. All data stays on the device — no account, no cloud, no tracking. An optional bring-your-own-key AI assistant is available but off by default.

## Product
- Platform: iOS 17.0+, iPhone, Apple Watch (watchOS 10+)
- Price: Free, with optional Pro (Monthly or Yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time Lifetime purchase)
- Privacy: local-first; no analytics or tracking. The only optional network feature is a bring-your-own-key AI assistant that sends the text you submit to the provider you choose.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6771795773

## Core features
- Interactive Life Grid — 13 built-in templates (4 free), Day/Week/Month/Year granularity, custom templates
- Rich moment timeline — List, Calendar, Map, Photos, and Statistics views
- Retrospect — automatic recaps (weekly, monthly, streak milestones, birthdays, completed countdowns) with background music, shareable as cards
- Story mode — full-screen, auto-advancing playback of your highlights
- Event timers — countdown or elapsed, custom icons and colors, on the grid and in widgets
- Companions — track people and pets, each with species-specific lifespans
- Data wallpapers — 3 styles, 5 layouts, device-adaptive
- Widgets — 6 variants across Home Screen and Lock Screen
- Apple Watch app — watchOS 10+, 4 complication styles (Circular, Corner, Rectangular, Inline), full watch app with progress bar, time remaining, and active events; data syncs from iPhone via Bluetooth/WiFi and is cached on the watch
- Optional AI assistant — bring-your-own-key, 7 supported providers, off by default
